mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 51 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, while the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

October is now officially Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their work on land use and housing. Additionally, you can book a free 30-minute ride on the tri-shaw bike at the Senior Center on the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is a lot to do today including the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival. Looking ahead, you can join trivia at Hop Haus this Monday or catch the farmer's market this coming Tuesday.
Looking at the records, on September 21, a suspect was identified through surveillance footage and cited for a retail theft incident involving Swedish Fish.
Treat yourself to the delicious Andes Mint Avalanche, as the Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM.
